pr_title: Fix rotate tool button in editor disabled when selecting 1 circle
pr_body:
Rotate button should now work when only 1 circle is selected, only playfield origin will be enabled while selection origin will be disabled.

EditorRadioButton is also untangled with the toolbox radio buttons.

Fixes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/26247

issue_context.title: Editor rotation popover incorrectly disabled when selecting a single hit circle
issue_context.body:
### Type

Game behaviour

### Bug description

If you select a single hit circle in the editor, the rotation tool will be disabled, but this is incorrect behaviour because you can still rotate the hit circle around the center of the playfield. 

`OsuSelectionRotationHandler.updateState` assumes that the rotation is always around the selection center, but this is not true. The editor rotation popover should use a different definition of `CanRotate` because it is more powerful than the rotation handles on the selection box.

### Screenshots or videos

_No response_

### Version

2023.1229.1

### Logs

comments: Notably the rotation operation *should* arguably continue to be inaccessible via the rotation handlers in the composer *in this specific case of a single hitobject being selected*, but the popover *should* become accessible.

review_comments: this can't just be renamed to "selection origin", there should be another bindable for absolute / playfield-coordinate rotation
There is, but I saw that only osu ruleset uses it, so it's inside the ruleset-specific rotate handler. If needed, I'll move it over to the generic rotate handler.
the generic handler supports both modes so both bindables should be there.
Will be fixed in later commits
